item.title: North Cobb Christian Defeats LFO 61-58 in Region Showdown
item.description: Fort Oglethorpe, GA-(WDEF-TV) In a region showdown on Friday night at LFO, North Cobb Christian held off the Warriors 61-58. It was a battle of the region’s top two teams. The Eagles remain unbeaten in region play with the win, while the Warriors drop to 10-3 in region action. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
